journeys.name: Register a new learner
journeys.description: Register a learner by entering their unique learner number and details, progressing through the add registration flow to confirmation.

journeys.name: Manage T Levels
journeys.description: Review pending T levels, confirm or query details, and manage confirmed or queried T levels from the dashboard.

journeys.name: Review and confirm T Level details
journeys.description: Review the details of individual T levels and either confirm or raise a query about them.

journeys.name: Manage or reinstate withdrawn learner registrations
journeys.description: Reinstate a previously withdrawn registration or register the learner to a new course.

journeys.name: Search for and review a learner’s record
journeys.description: Search for a learner using their unique learner number and view detailed information on their record.

journeys.name: Change or update a learner’s industry placement status
journeys.description: Add or edit industry placement details such as status, special consideration, and reasons from a learner's record.

journeys.name: Request a statement of achievement for a learner
journeys.description: Request a statement of achievement by searching for a withdrawn learner and completing the submission steps.
